For a renter, I’d look at a **portable power station bundled with a foldable solar panel**—not a kit that plugs into your apartment’s wiring. My compact pick is the **[BLUETTI Elite 30 V2 + 100 W panel kit](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-30-v2-100w-solar-kit)**. Its 288 Wh battery is suited to phones, a laptop, a router, or a fan; **it won’t run a fridge**. ([Kit details](https://dealectric.com/solar-generator-kit-for-an-apartment-balcony))

Keep the battery station indoors and put the panel on the balcony only if your lease and building rules allow it. Secure the panel so it can’t fall or blow away, and expect solar charging to vary with sun, shade, and balcony orientation. ([Apartment guide](https://www.solargenreview.com/articles/best-solar-generators-apartment))
